module: "Modal" translation operator of Easy Object Select, Blender-style: the G key starts moving the selection, X/Y/Z constrain to an axis, Shift+axis to a plane, pressing the same axis twice toggles world/local, typed digits give an exact distance (transformNumericInput), left click or Enter confirm, right click or Esc cancel. Relies on transformSession to apply and commit (undoable history) and on transformGizmo/debug for the guides.
notes: Without a constraint, the move happens in the view plane at the pivot's depth (center of the selection box).
The grid step (options.gridSize, absolute or relative) is ignored during numeric input.
The anchor is the last object of editor.selection.object; begin fails if a session is already active.

wantsBegin.desc: Indicates whether the G key has just been pressed.

returns.desc: true if G pressed this frame.

begin.desc: Starts the operation on the current editor selection (anchor = last object): opens a transformSession, stores pivot, camera, start ray, world/local axes, and hides the cursor.

options.desc: defaultLocal (boolean): start the constraints in local space.

update.desc: To be called every frame while the operation is active: handles cancel/confirm, constraints, numeric input, computes the delta and applies it via transformSession.updateDelta, then draws the guides.

returns.desc: nil if inactive; "active" while in progress; "confirm" or "cancel" at the end.
On confirm, end information ({anchorDistance} in m) returned by transformSession.finish.

cancel.desc: Cancels the current operation and restores the original transforms.

returns.desc: true if an operation was active.

drawScreen.desc: Draws the on-screen tooltip near the cursor: constraint, space, value (distance or typed input), grid, shortcut reminders.

options.desc: gridSize (m), gridRelative (boolean) for the grid display.

isActive.desc: Indicates whether an operation is in progress.

setLocalSpace.desc: Sets the default local/world space and applies it to the current constraint.

returns.desc: false if no operation is active.

getObjectIds.desc: IDs of the objects manipulated by the session.

status.desc: State summary: constraint ("VIEW", "X", "SHIFT+X"...), space ("WORLD"/"LOCAL"), typed numeric text and current delta.

returns.desc: {constraint, space, numeric, delta}, or nil if inactive.
